archimate:Principle.name: is Bank in scope
archimate:Principle.documentation:
CONTEXT
ICP has outlined a programme of work to conduct a technical refresh of HE’s core landscape, with a number of products assigned to accelerator teams. Traditionally, National Housing Bank (NHB) has not been in scope for this work, but the Solirius project team have been tasked with conducting desktop research building on the product work already done by the NHB team, and with Deloitte’s undertaking extensive requirement gathering. This ADR request formal confirmation that: 1. replacing the NHB investment platform in now in scope for the project team; 2. Interfaces between the investment platform and the other IT products in scope for ICP are part of project scope; or 3. No work on the investment platform is in scope.
PROPOSAL
This ADR proposes that the NHB investment plan is brought into scope for the ICP delivery team, to include: 1. Requirements gathering; 2. Product short listing and selection; and 3. Designing integration with other IT products in the landscape.
